reconstructed_captions.4: The soldier stops as a large C-130 military plane is seen flying low in the distance.
reconstructed_captions.5: The C-130 transport plane continues its low approach over the desert floor.
reconstructed_captions.6: The plane gets closer, its landing gear down as it prepares to land on the unprepared strip.
reconstructed_captions.7: The camera follows the C-130 as it flies just above the cracked earth, ready to touch down.
reconstructed_captions.8: The plane's wheels make contact with the ground, instantly kicking up a massive cloud of dust.
reconstructed_captions.9: As the C-130 rolls out, the dust cloud behind it grows exponentially.
reconstructed_captions.10: The billowing dust cloud begins to envelop the landing aircraft.
reconstructed_captions.11: The plane is now almost completely obscured by the thick, swirling cloud of dust.
reconstructed_captions.12: The massive dust cloud expands, engulfing the C-130 as it comes to a stop.
